MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A streaming stick would add a useful way to watch content alongside my TV and DVD player, provided it connects to my TV.",
    "Both streaming sticks fit that purpose, and HD suits my 720p TV; choosing the 4K model does not mean I need 4K or want both devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and smart plug introduce voice control, video calling, or smart lighting that I do not currently need; my tablet and power strips serve different practical purposes.",
    "The WYZE and Ring cameras address home monitoring, while my tripods, film, and lens cap point toward photography.",
    "The internal SSD does not serve my removable-memory needs, and my older Apple charging cables do not establish a current need for AirPods."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broader collection of Amazon and Alexa devices.",
    "Shared words such as camera, storage, or power seem to matter more than whether an item performs the particular job I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose accessories that help me use, connect, protect, or organize devices I already own, such as mounts, cables, memory-card holders, and readers.",
    "Compatibility and purpose matter: removable cards are different from internal drives, photography is different from security monitoring, and a streaming device needs to work with my existing TV.",
    "Several similar accessories in my history do not mean I currently need multiple substitutes; I would choose only one streaming stick."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a plausible TV-streaming need but stretched my practical accessory purchases into unsupported interest in smart-home devices and unrelated upgrades."
}
